en: Tell me more about the Western Crystal Pylon.
I want to catch Gahz'ranka!  Tell me how!
Ah - I've been waiting for a real challenge!
%s forces the fluid down the weary man's throat.
Freedom!
I am here!  And the Irondeep Mine is... MINE!
Oh, I can see Liladris from here... Tell her I'm here, won't you?

Rand Rhobart is fairly good at skinning felbats and the like.  You can find him at a camp along the road to the southeast of Brill.  Take the road southeast out of town and then head east at the intersection.
Release the hounds!

It is no light endeavor upon which you embark $n.  To get to Warsong Gulch you will want to speak to Aethalas, the Battlemaster of the Silverwing Sentinels.  She will guide your way.  Blessings of the Goddess be with you!
Ask me how to get a free drink at the Blue Recluse!
Sorry, ah'm late.
%s dreams up a horrendous vision. Something stirs beneath the murky waters.
Who dares violate the sanctity of my domain? Be warned: all who trespass here are doomed!
Hello, brother.
Any friend of the animals is a friend of mine.  The Hunter's Hall is what you seek.  It sits atop the Hunter Rise.
Be on your guard! There are reports of a humungous worm close to Hive'Zora!
%s vanishes.
We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.
Another day gone by...
Move!

I thank you for your inquiry, but I already have all of the wool bandages necessary for the war effort. I suggest that you ask around though; there are many here that could probably still use your aid.
May the Light protect you this day.
Please, light this while I am channeling.

If I am to teach you the secrets of summoning an infernal servant, you must destroy Kroshius and bring me the infernal core from his burning remains. This, however, is not as easy as it sounds. Kroshius has all but burned out completely. You must reignite his corpse and raise him from the rubble. To do this, however, you must gather some components from other demonic entities.$B$BMy imp, Impsy, shall set you on your way.
I'm here for the gold.
Let me think about it, Zamael.
They teach me to sneak good.  You find them in Rogues' Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.
Do not fail us!
Be healed, my pets!
Haha! I bet you thought you were done!
Ha ha, $n! I won't ever forget the look on Daryl's face when you showed him that head!
